text:
A sample of a radioactive material has a half-life of 20 minutes.
Which statement is correct?
A
After 30 minutes, less than half of the material has decayed.
B
After 40 minutes, all of the radioactive material has decayed.
C
After 60 minutes, an eighth of the radioactive material remains.
D
After 120 minutes, a sixth of the radioactive material remains.

options.label: A
options.text: After 30 minutes, less than half of the material has decayed.
